calculation_handling.description: A day nursery in an apartment building must be only on the first storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: Which storey a use occupies is not a model target (height_storeys is a building maximum).

units.disclosure: The rule that a day nursery in an apartment building be only on the first storey is not evaluated.

evidence.any: A day nursery in a public school

calculation_handling.description: A day nursery in a public or private school must be on the first storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: Which storey a use occupies is not a model target.

units.disclosure: The rule that a day nursery in a school be on the first storey is not evaluated.

evidence.any: A day nursery in a public school

calculation_handling.description: A day nursery in a school may have an interior floor area of no more than 40% of the gross floor area of the first storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: First-storey gross floor area is not held; gfa_m2 is the whole-building area.

units.disclosure: The 40% first-storey floor area cap on a day nursery in a school is not evaluated.

150.45.40.1(1).explanation: A day nursery in an apartment building must be only on the first storey.

150.45.40.1(2).explanation: A day nursery in a public or private school must be on the first storey, and its interior floor area may be no more than 40% of the gross floor area of the first storey of the building.
